name: BioLongevity Labs
legalEntity: F2 Nutrition, LLC dba BioLongevity Labs, PO Box 916, Bath, OH 44210 (privacy policy); the site footer names "F2 Nutrition Inc dba BioLongevity Labs"; office address 2498 Superior Ave, Cleveland, OH 44114 and phone (855) 699-5333 (contact page)
coaAccess: Public COA library (biolongevitylabs.com/coa) with 351 certificates for 103 compounds and 47 endotoxin reports, searchable by compound or batch; codes can be checked on the AV Analytics and MDx lab portals
dispatchInfo: Orders paid before 12 noon PT ship the same business day, later orders the next business day; USPS Priority, FedEx 2 Day, FedEx Overnight and FedEx Saturday delivery; domestic delivery 3-5 business days standard, 1-2 expedited; free shipping over $400; ships from the US to the US and a limited number of other countries such as Canada

subscore_reasons.labVerification: The COA library lists 351 certificates; of the 4 we opened, the semaglutide (AV Analytics COA-2026-26767) and BPC-157 (MDx 261666) reports resolved on the lab portals, while the tirzepatide report COA-2026-26765 and the TB-500 search code 261572 returned no record.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: All 4 opened reports measured 100.7% to 101.6% of label (10.07, 10.16, 10.16 and 10.13 mg for 10 mg vials), but 2 of them could not be confirmed on a lab portal.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: Reports cover UPLC/HPLC purity, mass-spectrometry identity, net content and endotoxin; no sterility or heavy-metal results found.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The privacy policy names F2 Nutrition, LLC with a PO box in Bath, Ohio, the footer says F2 Nutrition Inc, and the contact page gives a Cleveland street address and phone; no registration number found.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: Written policy with a 12 noon PT same-day cut-off, named carriers (USPS, FedEx) and delivery times; free shipping over $400.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Semaglutide $2.50/mg and tirzepatide $3.00/mg (10 mg vials) are below the median in our data, BPC-157 $5.60/mg is near it, and SS-31 $8.90/mg and selank $6.35/mg are above it.

strengths: Public COA library with 351 certificates and lab portal codes; 2 of 4 opened reports confirmed on the lab portals
All 4 opened reports measured within 100.7-101.6% of label with 99.76-99.81% purity
Endotoxin results on current certificates; named company, street address and phone
weaknesses: Tirzepatide report COA-2026-26765 not found on the AV Analytics portal; TB-500 search code 261572 not found on the MDx portal
The TB-500 certificate's chromatogram and mass spectrum are labelled with another batch and QC number (27-3-46143, QC261459) than its header (27-3-46148, QC 261476)
Legal form stated inconsistently (F2 Nutrition, LLC in the privacy policy, F2 Nutrition Inc in the footer)
GLP-1-class products sold under code names (BioG1, BioG2); the compound is named in page titles and lab reports
verdict: BioLongevity Labs publishes a large COA library with lab portal codes, and the 4 reports we opened showed 100.7-101.6% of label. Only 2 of the 4 could be confirmed on the lab portals, and the TB-500 certificate shows another batch number in its data. The company is named as F2 Nutrition, but its legal form is stated two ways.
summary: US shop (F2 Nutrition dba BioLongevity Labs, Ohio) with about 100 listings incl. capsules and bioregulators, a public COA library (AV Analytics, MDx) and GLP-1-class products under code names (BioG1, BioG2); ships to the US and a few other countries such as Canada.
notes: Official shop domain biolongevitylabs.com; the affiliate dashboard host affiliates.biolongevitylabs.com (HasOffers login titled Biolongevity Labs) is a subdomain of the same domain; the shop footer's Partner login points to bll.tellatribe.com. Payment: the shipping and payments page states "all major credit cards". Prices are single-vial regular prices from the product pages (schema.org offer data, same as the public WooCommerce Store API on cms.biolongevitylabs.com where listed); bundle tiers (buy 2 get 1 free, buy 3 get 2 free) not applied. Code names: BioG1 = semaglutide, BioG2 = tirzepatide, as named in the product page titles and in the AV Analytics reports. Capsules, creams, bioregulator capsules, blends, Follistatin/Klotho pairs and Cell Factors excluded. N-Acetyl Semax/Selank Amidate recorded as semax/selank as in the rest of our data. The shop-hosted AV Analytics images show page 1 of 3; the portal PDF for COA-2026-26767 adds an endotoxin result of 0.16 EU/mL against a 0.5 EU/mL limit, while the shop FAQ states a 0.05 EU/mL threshold. The TB-500 product page describes the acetylated LKKTETQ fragment; the MDx certificate identifies "TB-500 (TB-4 full chain)". AV Analytics and MDx reports name the same reviewer/operations manager (Jason Snitker). MDx search code 261476 (the TB-500 QC number) opens a CJC-1295 report for another sample. Portal records on AV Analytics show 2026-11-22 as the reported date for the certificates we looked up.
